cleanIntro: The 380 Shield EZ strips on a rotating takedown lever with no tool and no sear lever to press — the simplest field strip Smith & Wesson publishes for a striker-era carry pistol, and a deliberate part of the EZ design. Deep Clean is the magazine.

steps.title: Determine which features are present on your specific pistol
steps.action: Look your pistol over before you start and establish what it actually carries: an M&P380 Shield EZ may have a manual thumb safety lever, a ported barrel and slide, and one of two loaded chamber indicators. Every step below that talks about moving the slide assumes the thumb safety, if you have one, is down in FIRE. Note the model name and serial number marked on your pistol while you are looking; Smith & Wesson asks owners to record the serial number before shipping a firearm in for service.
steps.prose: The thumb safety is what changes the strip: up in SAFE it locks the slide, and an owner who does not know their pistol has one will decide the slide has seized. Porting changes what has to be cleaned and what the barrel may be paired with. Every EZ has the grip safety, so that is not the variable — it matters at reassembly rather than takedown.
steps.quote: YOU MUST DETERMINE WHICH FEATURES ARE PRESENT ON YOUR SPECIFIC SMITH & WESSON® PISTOL AND HOW THOSE FEATURES OPERATE. VARIOUS MODELS OF THE PISTOL ARE FITTED WITH DISTINCT FEATURES, WHICH MAY INCLUDE: ONE OF TWO LOADED CHAMBER INDICATORS, A PORTED BARREL AND SLIDE, AND A MANUAL THUMB SAFETY.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Model and Features Identification, WARNING, p.13
steps.warn: You must determine which features are present on your specific pistol and how those features operate.

steps.title: Magazine out, slide back, locked open on the slide stop
steps.action: Press the magazine release and remove the magazine. Then grasp the serrated sides of the slide from the rear, hold the pistol upright, and draw the slide briskly fully rearward to extract anything in the chamber. Lock it open by holding it fully back and pressing up on the slide stop lever.
steps.prose: The EZ's whole selling point is a slide light enough to rack without effort, which cuts both ways at the bench — it is easy to move it half-heartedly and pull a round part-way out of the chamber instead of throwing it clear. Brisk and complete, every time.
steps.quote: Lock the slide open by holding it fully rearward and pressing up on the slide stop lever (FIGURE 52).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.31

steps.title: Chamber and magazine well both empty
steps.action: With the slide locked open, make certain the chamber and the magazine well are empty and clear of any ammunition. Then unload the magazine separately.
steps.prose: Two places checked, not one — a round that failed to eject can be lying in the frame under the feed ramp where the chamber view will not show it. The EZ magazine has a load assist button on each side, so unloading it is a matter of pulling the button down slightly and pressing each round forward rather than fighting the spring.
steps.quote: Make certain that the pistol chamber and magazine well are empty and clear of any ammunition (FIGURES 53 and 54).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.31

steps.title: Nothing marked +P+ goes in this pistol
steps.action: Check the headstamps on what you have been shooting: +P+ ammunition must not be used in Smith & Wesson firearms.
steps.prose: The objection is that +P+ names no defined pressure standard at all — it is a loader's own marking, so two boxes wearing it can be far apart in what they generate. The EZ runs a light, easily cycled slide by design, and pressure it was not built for shows up first as battering at the frame rails and a slide that no longer locks back reliably.
steps.quote: “Plus-P-Plus” (+P+) ammunition must not be used in Smith & Wesson firearms.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Ammunition, p.11

steps.title: Use the magazine that came with this pistol
steps.action: Keep this pistol's own magazines with it, and do not interchange magazines from one model pistol to another model pistol.
steps.prose: EZ magazines look ordinary from the outside but carry the load assist buttons and a follower geometry specific to the model, so a magazine borrowed from another Shield will seat and latch and then fail to feed. On a bench holding parts from two pistols this is a real mix-up rather than a theoretical one.
steps.quote: Do not interchange magazines from one model pistol to another model pistol.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Loading, p.20

steps.title: Takedown lever down to 6 o'clock
steps.action: With the slide locked open, rotate the takedown lever down to the 6 o'clock position.
steps.prose: No tool, no ejector to press, no sear lever to reach through the port — this is where the 380 EZ is genuinely simpler than the Shield Plus and the Bodyguard 2.0, which both need something poked into the frame first. The lever stays in the frame; it is rotated, never removed.
steps.quote: Rotate the takedown lever down to the 6 o’clock position (FIGURE 55).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.32

steps.title: Ease the slide closed, then push it forward off the frame
steps.action: Grasp the serrated sides and draw the slide rearward until the slide stop disengages, then carefully let it move forward to its closed position. Push the slide forward off the frame with your thumb, keeping control of the recoil spring as it comes free.
steps.prose: Do not just thumb the slide stop down and let the slide slam — with the takedown lever rotated there is nothing holding the assembly together. Hold the frame by the sides rather than gripping it in the hand: squeezing the grip safety while the slide comes off is what makes it bind on this family.
steps.quote: Retain control of the recoil spring when the slide is removed from the frame (FIGURE 58).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.32
steps.warn: You must control the slide and the recoil spring during removal, to keep them from flying off and causing injury.

steps.title: Recoil spring off the barrel lug, then the barrel out
steps.action: Compress the recoil spring assembly slightly and lift it out from the barrel lug and slide. Then take the barrel out by grasping it by the lug and lifting up and back.
steps.prose: Up and back, not straight up — the barrel lug has to clear the slide's locking recess before the barrel will come out, and lifting vertically only wedges it. The spring assembly is keyed to the lug notch and comes out with a small compression rather than a pull.
steps.quote: Remove the barrel from the slide by grasping the barrel by the lug and lifting up and back (FIGURE 61).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, p.32

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly and magazine — that is the pistol field stripped for cleaning, and as far as Smith & Wesson takes it. Do not dry fire the pistol while the slide is removed. Deep Clean covers the magazine, which the manual documents separately.
steps.prose: The dry-fire warning is specific: with the slide off there is nothing for the hammer to fall against, and it damages the hammer or other internal parts.
steps.quote: DO NOT DRY FIRE YOUR M&P®380 SHIELD® EZ® PISTOL WHILE THE SLIDE IS REMOVED. DOING SO CAN RESULT IN DAMAGE TO THE HAMMER OR OTHER INTERNAL PARTS.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Field Stripping / Disassembly, WARNING, p.33

deepSteps.title: Hex wrench through the butt plate, catch depressed
deepSteps.action: With the magazine out and unloaded, use a small tool such as the hex wrench that comes in the box with the pistol to depress the butt plate catch through the hole in the butt plate, then slide the butt plate forward a little while holding the catch down.
deepSteps.prose: The supplied hex wrench is the right diameter for that hole, which is why the manual names it — a punch that is too fat will not reach the catch and a sharp one that slips scores the tube. Move the plate only a little at this stage; the catch has to stay held while it travels.
deepSteps.quote: Using a small tool like the hex wrench that comes in the box with the pistol, depress butt plate catch through the hole in the butt plate (FIGURE 80). Slide the butt plate forward a little bit while holding the catch down.
deepSteps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Magazine Disassembly, p.37
deepSteps.warn: The magazine spring is under pressure. Control the spring and follower so that they do not fly out and cause injury.

deepSteps.title: Butt plate off slowly, catch and spring out
deepSteps.action: Once the catch is unlocked, slide the butt plate off the tube slowly while controlling the butt plate catch against spring pressure, then remove the catch and spring out through the bottom of the tube.
deepSteps.prose: Slowly is the operative word — the catch is the part that launches, and it is sitting on a compressed spring the whole time. Note the way the spring's uphill slant faces before it leaves the tube: it goes back with that slant toward the front of the magazine.
deepSteps.quote: Once the catch is unlocked, slide the butt plate off of the tube slowly while controlling the butt plate catch in the tube against spring pressure (FIGURES 81 and 82).
deepSteps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual
For M&P
®380 SHIELD
® EZ
® PISTOLS — REV:M&P380_SHIELD_EZ-052626 — Magazine Disassembly, p.37

deepSteps.title: Load assist button out at the wide hole, then the follower
deepSteps.action: Slide the follower and load assist button down to the bottom of the tube where the wider hole allows the load assist button to be removed from the side, then take the follower out of the bottom of the tube.
deepSteps.prose: That wider hole near the base is the only place the button will leave, and its shape matches the button's — sliding the assembly down to it first is the whole trick, and prising at the button anywhere else breaks it. The longer side of the button goes on the left as viewed from the rear of the magazine, which is worth noting now rather than guessing later.
deepSteps.quote: Slide the follower and load assist button down to the bottom of the tube where the wider hole (FIGURE 83) will allow the load assist button to be removed from the side of the magazine tube
deepSteps.cite:

cleaning.name: BARREL AND CHAMBER
tasks: Remove excessive firing residue from the bore and chamber with a properly fitted brass brush dipped in gun cleaning solvent
Finish with a dry cotton cloth patch through the bore to remove residue and solvent
On a ported model, clean the barrel ports and the matching cuts in the slide
Clean the feed ramp and the barrel lug where the recoil spring seats

cleaning.name: SLIDE AND FRAME
tasks: Clean the breech face, the extractor and the inside of the slide
Clean the frame rails and the takedown lever recess
Clean around the grip safety without oiling it heavily — it has to move freely and dry
Clean the exterior with a non-abrasive cleaning cloth and remove all solution, oil and fingerprints

cleaning.name: MAGAZINE
tasks: Wipe the tube, the feed lips and both load assist button slots
If the magazine has been apart, clean the inside of the tube and the follower before reassembly
Check the butt plate is locked in place by applying a tug to it

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: A single drop of high-quality firearms lubricant at each of the marked points
Do not over-lubricate: excess collects unburned powder and carbon residue and interferes with proper functioning
Avoid prolonged solvent immersion and prolonged ultrasonic cleaning
Never use ammoniated or other strong alkaline solvents on this pistol

reassembly: Put the barrel back into the slide and fit the recoil spring assembly to the barrel lug, making sure it is seated and centred.
Hold the frame by its sides, not by the grip, and slide the slide assembly onto the frame rails from the front.
Lock the slide open on the slide stop, rotate the takedown lever back up into its horizontal locked position, then close the slide.

Magazine: install the follower from the bottom, insert the load assist button from the side into the follower with its longer side to the left as viewed from the rear, then the spring with its uphill slant toward the front, then the butt plate catch, and slide the butt plate on until it clicks.
A ported barrel goes back only into the ported slide it came from.
fncheck: With the pistol empty and pointed in a safe direction, confirm the takedown lever is rotated fully back up into its locked position. Cycle the slide by hand and check it runs fully into battery and that the slide stop locks it open and releases cleanly. Check the grip safety: with the grip not depressed the trigger should not release, and with a proper firing grip it should. If your pistol has the manual thumb safety, confirm the slide is locked with it up in SAFE. Then seat an empty magazine and confirm it latches and drops free.
